text.en: Dog owners praise Rob for his genuine dedication, professional reliability, and flexible scheduling over years of service. Reviewers note that he treats every pet with patience and thoughtfulness, whether conducting daily neighbourhood walks or overnight home boarding stays.

title.en: Skilled with nervous and large breeds

text.en: Clients frequently emphasize Rob's calm approach with reactive, energetic, or anxious dogs, including Cane Corsos and rescue pit mixes. Owners appreciate how comfortably their pets socialize with other friendly dogs and his resident dog Tito during structured play sessions.

Pet parents report excellent behavioural improvements, such as reliable command responses and dropping toys on cue. Dogs return home well exercised and happily tired after extended outdoor walks and structured boarding, giving owners complete peace of mind while away.

q.en: Does Rob offer both dog walking and boarding services?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly book weekday dog walking, short weekend boarding, and extended stays of up to three weeks.

q.en: How does Rob handle reactive or nervous dogs?

a.en: Reviewers note that Rob has extensive experience managing leash-reactive dogs and large breeds with patience and structured socialization.

q.en: Are regular updates sent during dog boarding?

a.en: Yes, owners report receiving daily photos, messages, and calendar invitations detailing their dog's activities and wellbeing.

q.en: Can dogs receive behavioural training while boarding?

a.en: Yes, Rob incorporates basic obedience manners and specific skills like dropping toys into boarding stays.
